fuente.titulo: Pope: ‘Accompanying Christians of the East is an essential work of hope' - Vatican News

bajada: Audience with CNEWA (Catholic Near East Welfare Association) · 2026
caption:
“When a Christian family is forced to leave its homeland, much more is lost than a place of residence: a community is weakened, a living tradition is placed at risk and the presence of the Church is diminished.”

— Pope Leo XIV, Audience with CNEWA (Catholic Near East Welfare Association) (2026)

Via Vatican News, 20 November 2026

#PopeLeoXIV #Vatican #CatholicChurch
